تعتكدين (form VIII)
# تَعْتَكِدِينَ (taʕtakidīna) /taʕ.ta.ki.diː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
# تُعْتَكَدِينَ (tuʕtakadīna) /tuʕ.ta.ka.diː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
